texts:
Sunday's Week 6 injury news, team by team, with Sunday night and Monday night still to play.

Ladd McConkey has a concussion.

Romeo Doubs hurt his shoulder.

DJ Moore sat again.
#BoltUp #NEPats #BillsMafia

Ladd McConkey was ruled out @KC with a concussion after 1 catch for 17 yards, with Tre Harris already out. WR21 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.
#BoltUp #ChiefsKingdom

Romeo Doubs left the win over the Jets in the first half with a shoulder injury. WR46 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.

A.J. Brown played his first game since Week 1. WR24 rest of season. Monitor; his snap share Monday.
#NEPats #JetUp

DJ Moore was inactive @LV with the shoulder, his second straight missed game. WR23 rest of season for me. Hold him unless he misses Wednesday's practice again.
#BillsMafia #RaiderNation

Blake Grupe, signed this week to replace Harrison Mevis, hurt his knee in the first quarter @ARI. Monitor; the Rams' kicker signings this week.
#RamsHouse #BirdGang

Tyler Warren sat out vs TEN with the groin. TE3 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.
#ForTheShoe #TitanUp

Quinshon Judkins sat out with the ankle, and Cleveland beat Baltimore. RB20 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.

Rashod Bateman was ruled out with the shoulder. WR66 rest of season; drop him for any add.
#DawgPound #RavensFlock

Alvin Kamara landed hard and went to the medical tent in the 34-27 win @NYG, then came back. RB45 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.

Darnell Mooney did not return with a neck injury. WR93; drop him for any add.
#Saints #NYGiants

Caleb Williams returned from the hamstring, and Chicago won @ATL. QB10 rest of season for me, a borderline QB1 from here.

Michael Penix Jr. went to the medical tent and returned. QB23 rest of season; drop him in 1-QB leagues for any add.
#DaBears #DirtyBirds

DK Metcalf played through the illness in Pittsburgh's overtime win @TB. WR33 rest of season for me; hold him.

Germie Bernard caught his first career TD from Aaron Rodgers. Monitor; his route share in Monday's snap counts.
#HereWeGo #GoBucs

Carson Steele was ruled out in the loss to Carolina with a shoulder injury.

Dameon Pierce is the healthy back left in Philadelphia. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report for Saquon Barkley.
#FlyEaglesFly #KeepPounding

DAL @GB on Sunday night.

CeeDee Lamb is WR3 for me.

Christian Watson is WR4 for me after 6 for 143 and 2 TDs vs CHI.

Tucker Kraft is TE6 for me.
#GoPackGo #DallasCowboys

Every Week 6 call is on the Pass, updated through Monday night. Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the rest of the week's calls, and like this if it saved your lineup.
